mutations.because: A fill that ignores its frame, in the shape somebody would actually write it: the kind is called `fill` and `fillRect(0, 0, width, height)` is what every other whole-canvas drawer in this file passes, so it reads as the obvious body. It stays invisible to everything structural — the drawer is still dispatched, at the template's position, on both the still and the timeline path; the layer order tests still record `fill`; the role still resolves through the brand; a disabled fill is still skipped; and the goldens do not move, because no canonical template carries the kind. What breaks is the only thing L11 promised: D131's worked example stops being a band under the copy and becomes a wash over the whole creative, swallowing the picture it was meant to sit beside. Caught only by reading pixels ABOVE the frame — an assertion inside the band passes either way, which is why the test names both halves.
